_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shop_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address_line" TEXT NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "pincode" TEXT NULL, "state_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "sale_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mrp_paise" INTEGER NULL, "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "price_includes_tax" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("price_includes_tax" IN (0, 1)), "hsn" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("track_stock" IN (0, 1)), "stock_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "low_stock_milli" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "image_path" TEXT NULL, "tracks_batches" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("tracks_batches" IN (0, 1)), "alt_unit" TEXT NULL, "alt_unit_factor_milli" INTEGER NULL, "alt_unit_price_paise" INTEGER NULL, "cost_price_paise" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parties" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'customer', "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address_line" TEXT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "state_code" TEXT NULL, "balance_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "fy_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "billed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "customer_name" TEXT NULL, "customer_phone" TEXT NULL, "items_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bill_discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "round_off_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "party_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES parties (id), "due_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "inter_state" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("inter_state" IN (0, 1)), "place_of_supply" TEXT NULL, "buyer_gstin" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("fy_start", "sequence"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "bill_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES items (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "hsn" TEXT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_includes_tax" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("price_includes_tax" IN (0, 1)), "discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bill_discount_share_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_factor_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000, "cost_paise" INTEGER NULL, "returned_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_counters" ("fy_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("fy_start"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "invoice_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INV', "round_to_rupee" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("round_to_rupee" IN (0, 1)), "upi_id" TEXT NULL, "receipt_footer" TEXT NULL, "printer_address" TEXT NULL, "printer_name" TEXT NULL, "paper_width_mm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 58, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_batches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "batch_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "expiry" INTEGER NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("item_id", "batch_no"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "batch_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES item_batches (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "bill_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "balance_after_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "party_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "party_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES parties (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bill_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "payment_mode" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "balance_after_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "party_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES parties (id), "supplier_name" TEXT NULL, "supplier_gstin" TEXT NULL, "supplier_invoice_no" TEXT NULL, "purchased_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "inter_state" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("inter_state" IN (0, 1)), "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "round_off_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "payment_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', "cancelled_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "purchase_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES items (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "hsn" TEXT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_includes_tax" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("cost_includes_tax" IN (0, 1)), "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "batch_no" TEXT NULL, "expiry" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "spent_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_notes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "note_no" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "fy_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bill_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "issued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "refund_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("fy_start", "sequence"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_note_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "credit_note_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES credit_notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "bill_line_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bill_lines (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_note_counters" ("fy_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("fy_start"));
CREATE INDEX items_name ON items (name)
CREATE INDEX bills_billed_at ON bills (billed_at)
CREATE INDEX movements_item ON stock_movements (item_id, at)
CREATE INDEX parties_name ON parties (name)
CREATE INDEX party_entries_party ON party_entries (party_id, at)
CREATE INDEX purchases_date ON purchases (purchased_at)
CREATE INDEX expenses_date ON expenses (spent_at)
CREATE INDEX credit_notes_date ON credit_notes (issued_at)
